summary.tldr: Creates a federal framework to keep cash available in Canada and bans the Bank of Canada from issuing a digital dollar.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to review laws, regulations and policies on cash access within 90 days of the bill coming into force.
Requires the minister to develop and implement a framework that keeps cash available across Canada, including access to withdrawals, deposits, cash acceptance, and cash donations.
Requires the framework to address the long-term viability of Canada’s cash infrastructure, including sorting, storing and distributing cash.
Requires the minister to table a report on the framework in Parliament within 18 months, then later review its implementation, effectiveness, and social and economic impacts.
Repeals the Governor in Council’s power to call in coins and notes under the Currency Act and bars the Bank of Canada from issuing a digital form of the dollar.
summary.background: The bill amends the Currency Act and the Bank of Canada Act. It also removes the Governor in Council’s power to call in coins and notes.
